method: Direct inspection of all nine iteration-45 pages at original resolution and the contact sheet. Pages 6 and 8 were re-inspected after mean-level wording changed in iteration 46; the other seven rendered pages were byte-identical. All nine iteration-47 page renders are byte-identical to iteration 46. Checked title and abstract, target and geometry, complete generator schematic and equations, result table, longitudinal plot, captions, section transitions, bibliography, margins, glyphs, and links.

observations.1-2: Title, abstract, literature framing, geometry after its first discussion, target definition, graph construction, and evaluation population are clear and unclipped.
observations.3-5: The compact generator schematic has larger print-scale labels contained within boxes. Its two flows, graph scorer, exact decoder, teacher forcing, equations, and diagnostics remain readable.
observations.6-7: The Results heading precedes the fixed table. Mean-level wording, longitudinal plot, numerical QA, and discussion are legible and contain no overlap or overflow.
observations.8-9: Conclusion, availability, declarations, and the complete 14-entry bibliography render cleanly. The reference continuation contains no isolated single-item spill.

iteration_findings: The first v0.8.0 build failed on an omitted closing math delimiter in the abstract; corrected. Iteration 42 failed five stale exact-phrase guards, replaced with equally strict new-phrase checks. Iteration 43 passed, then page review led to a more legible schematic; its first compact label was rejected by the new containment assertion and corrected. Iteration 44 passed, but direct review found two misplaced top floats, fixed for iteration 45. Iterations 45-47 passed the complete automated suite; the final iteration differs from 46 only in PDF container bytes, with identical rendered pages.
